summary: First-run E2E testing of CNC Takımhane app. Backend: 22/22 pytest tests pass (auth, seed, CRUD for products/personnel/machines, stock in/out flow with critical alert, dashboard, reports summary + Excel, auth protection). Frontend: login, dashboard KPIs, sidebar navigation, product create with new-category flow, product delete, stock-in submission all working. Turkish UI confirmed. Only minor React hydration warning noted (build tooling injects <span> inside <option>).

minor.issue: allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origin_regex='.*' is technically non-compliant with CORS spec (browsers may reject wildcard with credentials). Currently seems to work via reflected origin but should be tightened to explicit origins or CORS_ORIGINS env for production hardening.

design_issues.screen: Global (all pages with <select> options containing dynamic text)
issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Caused by build tooling (visual editor) wrapping expressions in <span> inside <option> tags in StockIn.jsx, StockOut.jsx, etc. Functional but pollutes console with hydration errors.

action_items: (Optional) Tighten CORS: use explicit origin whitelist instead of '.*' regex when credentials are enabled.
(Optional) Investigate build tooling injection of <span> inside <option> tags causing hydration warnings (may originate from x-* attribute injector in dev/preview build; not a blocker).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 648 lines — approaching the 700-line soft cap; consider splitting routers into modules (auth/products/personnel/machines/stock/dashboard/reports).
startup event uses deprecated @app.on_event; migrate to FastAPI lifespan context for future compatibility.
Password policy is min 6 chars; consider strengthening (min 8 + complexity) though acceptable for MVP.
No brute-force lockout on /auth/login (playbook mentions 5-fail lockout expectation).
Cookie set with SameSite='none' + Secure — correct for cross-origin, but no CSRF protection; API relies on JWT so mostly OK.
Excel export returns full dataset (limit 50000) without pagination; large tenants could OOM. Not critical for MVP.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (login, dashboard, sidebar nav, product CRUD + new category, stock-in submission, logout)

seed_data_creation: Not needed — server auto-seeds 8 products, 5 personnel, 4 machines. Verified counts. Critical products from seed: KU-002, MT-002, OL-002 (matches spec).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; run with pytest ... --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. All 22 backend tests green. Test data uses TEST_/TESTUI- prefixes and cleans up. For UI, note: (1) Registration page redirects logged-in users to /, so log out first before testing /kayit. (2) Product select options need ~2-3s wait after page load for products fetch. (3) Delete uses native window.confirm — accept via dialog handler.
